Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited by Redwood's latency numbers and the private deployment options. We're trying to map next steps for a potential reseller/co-sell relationship and want to confirm: does Redwood have a published co-sell eligibility checklist that covers both GTM (contacts, logos, pipeline commitments) and technical readiness (LangChain/LlamaIndex connector support, tracing hooks, SDK co-branding)?

Our team (Jorge and I) are preparing an internal partner packet and it would help to get a single doc or checklist so we can align procurement and platform teams. Also curious whether there are standard integration blockers you've seen when ISVs embed Redwood as a runtime (auth flows, keys, telemetry exposure).

Appreciate any existing artifact — otherwise a short call works.

Best,

Short answer: yes, we have a combined GTM + technical eligibility checklist we use for ISV partners, and we typically run a light tech validation for LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter compatibility and tracing instrumentation before approving co-sell. I'll loop in Marissa (partner ops) and Karthik (integration lead) — they can share the formal checklist and flag any typical blockers.

Can you share a quick list of the product flows you're planning to integrate (e.g., hosted API calls vs private deployment, whether you need embedding runtime or generative chat)? That will help us highlight the relevant sections.

I can also send our co-sell criteria doc as a starting point — would you prefer PDF or a shared Drive doc?

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 17 Apr 2028 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick ask — co-sell eligibility + integration checklist

Hi Clara — attaching our CoSell_Criteria_v2.pdf (stapled below). Summary of the technical section here to save time: 

- Supported integration patterns: hosted API (REST + SDKs), dedicated capacity (reserved pools), private deployment (VPC/on-prem).
- LangChain/LlamaIndex: we validate adapter compatibility, provide sample shim code for token attribution and KV cache handling, and require a small tracer hook (OpenTelemetry) for transaction-level visibility.
- Typical blockers we see: long-tail auth (customer-managed KMS), telemetry PII redaction questions, and embedding format mismatches for legacy LlamaIndex stores.
- Minimum GTM commitments for co-sell: single point of contact, joint case studies timeline, and lead sharing cadence.

Next steps: 1) Clara/Jorge — confirm you have an SSO integration plan and whether enterprise customers will bring their own KMS. 2) We'll schedule a 45min technical validation with Karthik and one of our runtime engineers.

Attaching: CoSell_Criteria_v2.pdf

Thanks,
